**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 sits at or above the playbook's preferred position:

- **19.1** — professional/workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications (no time limit on the performance warranty itself).
- **19.2** — 90 days from the *later* of delivery or acceptance for each Deliverable, and hosted Services conform for the **entire subscription term**, which exceeds the 12-month software benchmark.
- **19.3** — no-malicious-code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminution, and open-source protection.
- **19.4** — the full remedy ladder: prompt re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, then termination and refund of Fees paid, and expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — the disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the warranty.

Acceptance remedies in 6.2 (correction cycles, then termination and refund) reinforce rather than displace this. Nothing here needs to be traded for.
